subject: Data Science
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for ICT Skills-III in CBSE Class 11 Data Science.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Data Science (844), Unit-3: ICT Skills-III covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
